name: FunCAD
title: Can It Actually Work? Synthesizing Functional CAD Mechanisms
summary: LLM agents turn user requests into functional CAD mechanisms, guided by physical tests tailored to each design.
authors: Wenqian Zhang, Yangyi Huang, Zigeng Xu, Weiyang Liu, Zhen Liu
imageAlt: From a user request to an agent-designed prototype: a request to reach a rear cup, its functional goals, the CAD mechanism tested in simulation, and the 3D-printed prototype lifting the cup.

name: BesiegeField
title: Compositional Machine Design as Program Synthesis with LLMs
summary: Language-model agents build machines as programs and refine them through physical simulation.
authors: Wenqian Zhang, Yangyi Huang, Weiyang Liu, Zhen Liu
imageAlt: Machines designed and evaluated in the BesiegeField simulation environment.

name: EVA
title: EVA: Aligning Video World Models with Executable Robot Actions via Inverse Dynamics Rewards
summary: Aligning video world models with actions a robot can execute.
authors: Ruixiang Wang, Qingming Liu, Yueci Deng, Guiliang Liu, Zhen Liu, Kui Jia
imageAlt: EVA aligns video generation with executable robot actions and supports video generation, action planning, and VLA training.

name: DrPO
title: Drifting Preference Optimization for One-Step Generative Models
summary: Turning sample preferences into feature-space update directions for one-step image generators.
authors: Zhou Jiang, Yandong Wen, Zhen Liu
imageAlt: DrPO method overview showing preference and reference drift in feature space, with generated samples across finetuning steps.

name: PAct

authors: Qingming Liu, Xinyue Yao, Shuyuan Zhang, Yueci Deng, Guiliang Liu, Zhen Liu, Kui Jia
imageAlt: PAct generates articulated furniture and appliances with movable parts.

name: ASAP

authors: Bao Li, Yuliang Xiu, Zhen Liu

name: VGG-Flow

authors: Zhen Liu, Tim Z. Xiao, Weiyang Liu, Yoshua Bengio, Dinghuai Zhang
imageAlt: Nabla-GFlowNet method diagrams showing gradient-informed diffusion alignment, alongside diverse generated animals across finetuning steps.

imageAlt: G-Shell represents open surfaces and supports mesh reconstruction and generation, illustrated with clothing shapes.
